methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $5M total raised proxy.

data.narrative:
Clippership is a seed-stage ocean and maritime technology company that has raised $5M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a universe of three private comparables in the sector (Standard Subsea, NetworkOcean, and Albacore); no public maritime-tech peers provide direct benchmarking support.

A stage-progression methodology is applicable here, using the $5M total raised as a proxy baseline. Applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $12M. This represents a straightforward step-up from the capital deployed to date, reflecting expected value creation between seed and Series A funding rounds.

The triangulation across available methodologies supports a valuation range of $11M to $14M, with a median point of $12M. The relatively narrow band reflects reliance on a single applicable method; meaningful refinement would require additional comparable transaction data from the private maritime-tech market or revenue/operational metrics from Clippership itself. Key uncertainties include the company's actual burn rate, customer traction, and how peers in the space have progressed from seed funding. Investors should treat this range as preliminary pending deeper diligence on unit economics and market positioning within the ocean-tech sector.
